_instructions: Copy this file to test-sheets-config.json and fill in your credentials

_howToGetCredentials.step3: Enable Google Sheets API: APIs & Services > Library > Google Sheets API
_howToGetCredentials.step4: Create Service Account: APIs & Services > Credentials > Create Credentials > Service Account
_howToGetCredentials.step5: Create JSON key: Click service account > Keys tab > Add Key > Create new key > JSON
_howToGetCredentials.step6: Copy client_email and private_key from downloaded JSON file
_howToGetCredentials.step7: Get spreadsheetId from your Google Sheet URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SPREADSHEET_ID/edit
_howToGetCredentials.step8: Share your Google Sheet with the service account email (give Editor access)
